title: Cow wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="30" ry="20" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="68" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#7a5fa8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="80" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#7a5fa8"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="28" y="86" width="7" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <rect x="40" y="88" width="7" height="9" rx="2" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <rect x="56" y="88" width="7" height="9" rx="2" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <rect x="66" y="86" width="7" height="10" rx="2" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="28" y="94" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <rect x="40" y="95" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <rect x="56" y="95" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <rect x="66" y="94" width="7" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#f4f4f8"/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="38" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#7a5fa8"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="42" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#e0b8c8" transform="rotate(-20 26 42)"/>
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="42" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#e0b8c8" transform="rotate(20 74 42)"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="57" rx="13" ry="9" fill="#f7c8d4"/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="55" rx="2" ry="2.5" fill="#c88098"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="55" rx="2" ry="2.5" fill="#c88098"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="45" r="3.5" fill="#3a2a5a"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="45" r="3.5" fill="#3a2a5a"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="44" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points="50,12 38,34 62,34" fill="#ff5fa2"/>
  <polygon points="44,23 50,12 56,23 50,20" fill="#ffd23f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="11" r="3.5" fill="#4ad0ff"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="30" r="2" fill="#4ad0ff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="30" r="2" fill="#ffd23f"/>
</svg>
